key.name: glass
key.description: Menus and the top bar are translucent over a blur of what is behind them.

key.name: lighting
key.description: Menus catch light from the button that opened them.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: How tinted the glass is, from clear (0) to fully tinted (1).

key.name: window-glass
key.description: App windows' chrome (the window ground, header bars, sidebars) is a little translucent over a blur of the wallpaper; content stays solid. Apps opened afterwards pick it up.

key.name: power-on
key.description: A surface's rim traces out from the light when it appears. Needs Lighting.

key.name: glow
key.description: What is filled with the accent -- a switched-on toggle, today in the calendar, the default button, a slider's fill -- glows softly in it, in the Shell and in apps opened afterwards.

key.name: glass-off-gaming
key.description: While a game is running (GameMode has a client), the Shell's glass and light are off, as if switched off. Windows opened with glass keep it.

key.name: glass-off-power-saver
key.description: While the power mode is Power Saver, the Shell's glass and light are off, as if switched off. Windows opened with glass keep it.

key.name: focus-brackets
key.description: Corner brackets lock onto the control the keyboard is on, beside the focus ring.
